title: Shopping list
description: Create an ArrayList of String with 5 products from a shopping list. Remove 2 products and show the resulting list.
hints: Use compras.add("Leche") to add each product
Use compras.remove("nombre") or compras.remove(index) to remove
Printing an ArrayList shows its contents between brackets
solutionExplanation: An empty ArrayList is created and 5 elements are added with add(). Then 2 are removed with remove() using the product name. The ArrayList adjusts automatically after each removal.

title: Grades list
description: Given an ArrayList<Double> with student grades, calculate the average and count how many passed (grade >= 6.0).
hints: Use for (double nota : notas) to iterate
Accumulate suma += nota on each iteration
Use if (nota >= 6.0) to count those who passed
solutionExplanation: The ArrayList is iterated with a for-each, accumulating the sum of all grades. On each iteration it checks whether the grade is >= 6.0 to increment the pass counter. The average is the sum divided by the number of elements.

title: Duplicate filter
description: Given an ArrayList<Integer> with duplicate values, remove the duplicates keeping the original order of appearance.
hints: Create a second ArrayList for the results
Use contains() to check whether an element was already seen
Iterate with a for-each or an index
solutionExplanation: A second ArrayList is used to build the list without duplicates. For each element of the original, it checks whether it already exists in the second ArrayList with contains(). If it does not exist, it is added. This preserves the order of first appearance.
